(Combined notes from Times of Israel + Al Jazeera search snippet content)

Israel-Lebanon situation 14-15 May 2026:

Casualties:
- Israeli warplanes targeted Ezzedine residential project in Srifa, southern Lebanon, on Thursday morning 14 May
- Two killed in Srifa strike
- Four Israeli civilians wounded, one critically, in Hezbollah drone attack on Rosh Hanikra area (14 May)
- 6 Hezbollah operatives killed in firefight in Bint Jbeil
- 12 people killed in Israeli strikes on Wednesday (mostly south of Beirut)
- Over 20 Hezbollah operatives killed in Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon over 24 hours
- IDF struck ~65 Hezbollah infrastructure sites in 24 hours (weapon depots, surveillance posts, command centers)

Lebanon Ministry of Public Health: at least 2,896 people killed in Israeli attacks since conflict resumed in early March.

Washington talks:
- Israeli and Lebanese officials meeting in Washington DC on Thursday 14 May for third round of US-mediated talks
- Talks aimed at extending ceasefire which expires Sunday
- Stated aim: "a comprehensive peace and security agreement that substantively addresses the core concerns of both countries"

Israel ramped up southern Lebanon attacks ahead of the Washington talks, issuing forced displacement orders.

Netanyahu remarks (Times of Israel):
- "The regime of terror in Iran is weaker than ever, and the State of Israel is stronger than ever"
- Vowed Jerusalem will remain forever under Israeli control
